title: 太宰府天満宮・博多ラーメンなど福岡を 2日で楽しむルート
titleTranslation: Dazaifu Tenmangu, Hakata Ramen, and More: A Route to Enjoy Fukuoka in 2 Days
summary: This easy-Japanese travel guide from MATCHA lays out a one-night, two-day route for enjoying Fukuoka, covering shopping in Tenjin, ramen at Ichiran, Seaside Momochi Park and Fukuoka Tower, Nakasu's food stalls, Don Quijote, Ohori Park, Dazaifu Tenmangu shrine, and shopping at Hakata JR City before flying out.

sentences.text: 福岡で　ゆうめいな　太宰府天満宮、博多ラーメンを　食べられる　場所、かいものが　たくさん　できる　場所の　天神など、1泊2日で　たのしむ　ルートを　紹介します。

tokens.gloss: Tenmangu (Shinto shrine dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane)

sentences.translation: We introduce a route to enjoy in one night and two days, including the famous Dazaifu Tenmangu in Fukuoka, places where you can eat Hakata ramen, and Tenjin, a place with lots of shopping.

sentences.text: 福岡を　1泊2日で　楽しむ　ルート
sentences.translation: A Route to Enjoy Fukuoka in One Night and Two Days

sentences.text: 福岡県　福岡市は、昔から　あるもの、今　人気があるもの、どちらも　楽しむことが　できる　街です。
sentences.translation: Fukuoka City, Fukuoka Prefecture, is a city where you can enjoy both things that have existed since long ago and things that are popular now.

sentences.text: 今回は、博多ラーメンなどの　福岡の　食べ物、買い物、観光など　福岡を　1泊2日で　楽しむ　ルートを　紹介します！
sentences.translation: This time, we introduce a route to enjoy Fukuoka's food such as Hakata ramen, shopping, sightseeing, and more, in one night and two days!

sentences.text: 九州の　一部の　新幹線や　電車が　乗り放題(※)になる「JR KYUSHU RAIL PASS」を　使えば、熊本や　別府温泉、ハウステンボスが　ある　長崎などに　行くことも　できます。

tokens.gloss: as much as one likes, unlimited
Huis Ten Bosch (theme park in Nagasaki)

sentences.translation: If you use the "JR KYUSHU RAIL PASS," which lets you ride some Kyushu shinkansen and trains as much as you like, you can also go to places like Kumamoto, Beppu Onsen, and Nagasaki, home to Huis Ten Bosch.

sentences.text: 九州の　りょこうに　べんりな　JR KYUSHU RAIL PASSについて　くわしく　しる
sentences.translation: Learn more about the JR KYUSHU RAIL PASS, which is convenient for traveling in Kyushu

sentences.text: 1日目　午前｜天神でショッピング！
sentences.translation: Day 1 Morning | Shopping in Tenjin!

sentences.text: 1日目の　午前中は、天神駅の　近くを　観光します。
sentences.translation: On the morning of Day 1, we go sightseeing near Tenjin Station.

sentences.text: 「天神」は　福岡の　中心地(※)で、ショッピングに　ちょうどいい　場所です。
sentences.translation: "Tenjin" is the center of Fukuoka, and a perfect place for shopping.

sentences.text: ブランドの　服や　化粧品(※)、食べ物を　買いたいときは「大丸 福岡天神店」や「福岡三越」に　行くと　いいでしょう。
sentences.translation: If you want to buy brand-name clothes, cosmetics, or food, it's a good idea to go to "Daimaru Fukuoka Tenjin Store" or "Fukuoka Mitsukoshi."

sentences.text: 新しい　人気が　ある　ものを　買いたいときは　「福岡PARCO」や「SOLARIA STAGE」に　行ってみて　ください。

tokens.gloss: to give (polite; used in ~てください)

sentences.translation: If you want to buy new, popular items, try going to "Fukuoka PARCO" or "SOLARIA STAGE."

sentences.text: 天神には　いろいろな　お店が　集まっています。
sentences.translation: Many different shops are gathered in Tenjin.

sentences.text: そして天神の　地下(※)には「天神の　地下街」が　あります。
sentences.translation: And underground in Tenjin, there is the "Tenjin Underground Shopping Mall."

sentences.text: ここは、空港線などの　電車の　改札(※)から　そのまま　行くことが　できる　場所です。
sentences.translation: This is a place you can go to directly from the ticket gates of trains like the Airport Line.

sentences.text: 服、雑貨(※)、食べ物など　150くらいの　店が　並んでいます。
sentences.translation: About 150 shops line the mall, selling clothes, miscellaneous goods, food, and more.

sentences.text: 雨の日でも　ショッピングを　楽しめますよ。
sentences.translation: You can enjoy shopping even on rainy days.

sentences.text: 【天神】Google Mapで　場所を　みる
sentences.translation: [Tenjin] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 1日目　昼｜一蘭で　ランチ！

tokens.gloss: orchid (part of 一蘭, Ichiran ramen shop name)

sentences.translation: Day 1 Noon | Lunch at Ichiran!

sentences.text: ランチには、天神駅から　歩いて　10分ほどで　行ける、日本で　有名な　人気の　ラーメン店「一蘭」で　豚骨ラーメンを　食べましょう。

tokens.gloss: orchid (part of 一蘭, Ichiran ramen shop name)

sentences.translation: For lunch, let's eat tonkotsu ramen at "Ichiran," a famous and popular ramen shop in Japan, about a 10-minute walk from Tenjin Station.

sentences.text: こちらで　ぜひ　食べてほしい　ラーメンは、ふつうの　どんぶりとは　違う　どんぶりに　入っている　釜だれトンコツラーメンです。

tokens.gloss: sauce (as in 釜だれ, kettle sauce)

sentences.translation: The ramen we really want you to try here is the Kamadare Tonkotsu Ramen, served in a bowl different from the usual one.

sentences.text: このラーメンは、天神西通り店だけで　食べられます。
sentences.translation: This ramen can only be eaten at the Tenjin Nishi-dori branch.

sentences.text: 【一蘭天神西通り店】Google Mapで場所をみる

tokens.gloss: orchid (part of 一蘭, Ichiran ramen shop name)

sentences.translation: [Ichiran Tenjin Nishi-dori Store] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 1日目　午後｜シーサイドももち海浜公園＆福岡タワー
sentences.translation: Day 1 Afternoon | Seaside Momochi Seaside Park & Fukuoka Tower

sentences.text: 天神から　バスに　乗って、福岡の　海の　近くに　行きます。
sentences.translation: Take a bus from Tenjin to go near the sea in Fukuoka.

sentences.text: ビーチの　散歩や　ショッピングが　楽しめる　公園「シーサイドももち海浜公園」に　行きましょう。
sentences.translation: Let's go to "Seaside Momochi Seaside Park," a park where you can enjoy a beach walk and shopping.

sentences.text: 公園には、海に　ある　店の「マリゾン」があり、海を　見ながら　ゆっくり　カフェや　レストランで　休むことが　できます。
sentences.translation: In the park there is a shop called "Marizon" on the sea, where you can relax at a cafe or restaurant while looking at the ocean.

sentences.text: 【シーサイドももち海浜公園】Google Mapで場所をみる
sentences.translation: [Seaside Momochi Seaside Park] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: さらに　公園には、234ｍの　高さから　福岡の　景色を　360°　見ることが　できる「福岡タワー」が　あります。
sentences.translation: Furthermore, in the park there is "Fukuoka Tower," where you can see a 360° view of Fukuoka from a height of 234m.

sentences.text: 夜も、　夜の　福岡の　街の　景色と、タワーの　ライトアップが　きれいです！
sentences.translation: At night too, the night view of Fukuoka's cityscape and the tower's lighting are beautiful!

sentences.text: 【福岡タワー】Google Mapで場所をみる
sentences.translation: [Fukuoka Tower] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 1日目　夜｜中洲屋台横丁で　福岡の　料理を　楽しむ！
sentences.translation: Day 1 Night | Enjoy Fukuoka Food at Nakasu Yatai Food Stall Alley!

sentences.text: 「中洲屋台横丁訪れたい　有名な　場所です。
sentences.translation: "Nakasu Yatai Food Stall Alley" is a famous place people want to visit.

sentences.text: 海浜公園から　バスで　中洲の　屋台横丁に　行きます。
sentences.translation: Take a bus from the seaside park to the food stall alley in Nakasu.

sentences.text: ここでは、カウンター席で　いろいろな　料理を　食べられます。
sentences.translation: Here, you can eat various dishes at counter seats.

sentences.text: 焼き鳥や　おでん、博多ラーメンなどを　福岡の　人たちと　一緒に　楽しみましょう。
sentences.translation: Let's enjoy things like yakitori, oden, and Hakata ramen together with the people of Fukuoka.

sentences.text: 【中洲屋台横丁】Google Mapで場所をみる
sentences.translation: [Nakasu Yatai Food Stall Alley] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 1日目　深夜｜24時間やっている　ドン・キホーテで　おみやげを　買いましょう！
sentences.translation: Day 1 Late Night | Let's buy souvenirs at Don Quijote, which is open 24 hours!

sentences.text: 「ドン・キホーテ 福岡天神本店」は　24時間やっている　お店です。
sentences.translation: "Don Quijote Fukuoka Tenjin Main Store" is a shop open 24 hours.

sentences.text: 中洲屋台横丁から　歩いて　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: You can walk there from Nakasu Yatai Food Stall Alley.

sentences.text: MATCHAでは、日本に　旅行にきた　外国人が　使える　クーポンを　用意しています。
sentences.translation: MATCHA has prepared coupons that foreign visitors traveling in Japan can use.

sentences.text: こちらを　使って、福岡の　ドン・キホーテで　ショッピングを　楽しんでくださいね！

tokens.gloss: to give (polite; used in ~てください)

sentences.translation: Please use this and enjoy shopping at Don Quijote in Fukuoka!

sentences.text: 【ドン・キホーテ 福岡天神本店】Google Mapで場所をみる
sentences.translation: [Don Quijote Fukuoka Tenjin Main Store] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 2日目　午前｜大濠公園を　散歩しよう！
sentences.translation: Day 2 Morning | Let's Walk in Ohori Park!

sentences.text: 2日目の　朝は、「大濠公園」に　行きましょう。
sentences.translation: On the morning of Day 2, let's go to "Ohori Park."

sentences.text: 公園には「スターバックス コーヒー 福岡大濠公園店」が　あるので、コーヒーを　飲みながら　散歩を　するのも　いいですよ。
sentences.translation: There is a "Starbucks Coffee Fukuoka Ohori Park Store" in the park, so it's also nice to walk while drinking coffee.

sentences.text: ここは　福岡の　人も　よく　来る　場所です。
sentences.translation: This is a place that people from Fukuoka often visit too.

sentences.text: 犬の　散歩や　ジョギング、ウォーキングをしている　人が　たくさん　います。
sentences.translation: There are many people walking their dogs, jogging, and walking.

sentences.text: 草間彌生さんの　作品(※)を　見ることが　できる「福岡市美術館」も　公園のなかに　あります。
sentences.translation: The "Fukuoka Art Museum," where you can see works by Yayoi Kusama, is also inside the park.

sentences.text: 【大濠公園】Google Mapで場所をみる
sentences.translation: [Ohori Park] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 2日目　午後｜太宰府を　楽しもう！
sentences.translation: Day 2 Afternoon | Let's Enjoy Dazaifu!

sentences.text: 次は、電車に　乗って「太宰府天満宮」へ　行きましょう。

tokens.gloss: Tenmangu (Shinto shrine dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane)

sentences.translation: Next, let's take a train to "Dazaifu Tenmangu."

sentences.text: 試験などの　合格を　お願いするために　毎年　多くの人が　訪れる　神社です。

tokens.gloss: for the purpose of, because of

sentences.translation: It's a shrine visited by many people every year to pray for success on exams and other things.

sentences.text: 大濠公園から　バスに　10分ほど　乗って　天神駅に　行き、天神駅から　西鉄電車に　20分ほど　乗って　太宰府に　行きます。
sentences.translation: From Ohori Park, ride a bus for about 10 minutes to Tenjin Station, then from Tenjin Station ride the Nishitetsu train for about 20 minutes to get to Dazaifu.

sentences.text: 神社へ　行くまでの　道には　たくさん　お店が　並んでいます。
sentences.translation: Along the road to the shrine, many shops line the street.

sentences.text: あんこが　入った　おかしの　梅ヶ枝餅が　有名です。
sentences.translation: Umegae-mochi, a sweet filled with red bean paste, is famous.

sentences.text: 【太宰府天満宮】Google Mapで場所をみる

tokens.gloss: Tenmangu (Shinto shrine dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane)

sentences.translation: [Dazaifu Tenmangu] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 2日目　夕方｜空港まで　15分！
sentences.translation: Day 2 Evening | 15 Minutes to the Airport!

sentences.text: 博多JRシティで　最後まで　料理や　ショッピングを　楽しもう
sentences.translation: Enjoy food and shopping to the very end at Hakata JR City

sentences.text: 旅行の　最後は　太宰府から　電車で　博多駅に　行って、駅から　そのまま　行ける「博多JRシティ」に　行きましょう。
sentences.translation: At the end of the trip, take the train from Dazaifu to Hakata Station, and let's go to "Hakata JR City," which you can reach directly from the station.

sentences.text: 博多JRシティは、「博多阪急」、「KITTE博多」、「アミュプラザ博多」など　お店が　たくさん　あります。
sentences.translation: Hakata JR City has many shops, such as "Hakata Hankyu," "KITTE Hakata," and "Amu Plaza Hakata."

sentences.text: そこで　買い物も　料理も　楽しめます。
sentences.translation: There, you can enjoy both shopping and food.

sentences.text: 博多駅から　福岡空港まで　電車で　15分くらいで　行けるので、最後まで　福岡旅行を　楽しむことが　できますよ！
sentences.translation: You can get from Hakata Station to Fukuoka Airport by train in about 15 minutes, so you can enjoy your Fukuoka trip right up to the end!

sentences.text: 【JR博多シティ】Google Mapで場所をみる
sentences.translation: [JR Hakata City] View the location on Google Maps

sentences.text: 1泊2日の　福岡旅行を　楽しもう！
sentences.translation: Let's Enjoy a One Night, Two Day Trip to Fukuoka!

sentences.text: 福岡には　ショッピングが　できる場所や　料理が　おいしい　店、公園など　たくさん　楽しい　場所が　あります。
sentences.translation: Fukuoka has many fun places, such as places to shop, restaurants with delicious food, and parks.

sentences.text: この記事で　紹介した　ルートで　ぜひ、福岡を　楽しんで　ください！

tokens.gloss: to give (polite; used in ~てください)

sentences.translation: Please be sure to enjoy Fukuoka using the route introduced in this article!

sentences.text: 2022年5月24日に書いた記事を、2023年10月にリライトしました。
sentences.translation: This article, originally written on May 24, 2022, was rewritten in October 2023.
